ig_caption:
Kubernetes pod stuck in Pending: "Insufficient memory" ⏳

Pending for 10 minutes. No error, no crash. It just never starts.
The events say it plainly: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient memory.

⚠️ the embedding service requests 16Gi of memory
⚠️ the node has ~7.5 GiB allocatable

A request is a promise: the scheduler must find a node that can keep it. No node can, so the pod waits. Forever.

The fix:
✅ request what the app really uses, plus headroom (512Mi)
✅ a sensible limit (1Gi)

Same deploy → scheduled → Running.

Save this for your next deploy 🔖 Follow for more Kubernetes breaks.

yt_title: Kubernetes pod stuck in Pending: Insufficient memory #kubernetes
yt_description:
Real run on a local kind cluster: requests.memory: 16Gi on a node with ~7.5 GiB allocatable → Pending for 10 minutes, event "0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient memory".
Requests are reservations the scheduler must honour; if no node can fit them, the pod never starts.
Fix: requests.memory: 512Mi (real usage + headroom), limits.memory: 1Gi → scheduled and Running.
